title: NSGo game behavior tree (version 1)
description: BehaviorTreeDoc is the root of a versioned YAML behavior tree document (*.bt.yaml).

version.description: Version is the schema version; must equal BTFormatVersion (1).

name.description: Name is an optional human-readable identifier for this behavior tree.

params.description: Params declares optional default parameter values substituted for "${name}" references in this tree.

blackboard.description: Blackboard declares typed blackboard keys and optional initial defaults used by this tree.

root.description: Root is the root node of the behavior tree.

BTBlackboardKeyDoc.description: BTBlackboardKeyDoc declares one typed blackboard key and its optional initial default value.

key.description: Key is the blackboard key name.

type.description: Type is the value kind: bool, int, float, string, vec2, vec3, or entity.

shared.description: Shared targets the parent (squad or team) blackboard instead of the agent's local blackboard when seeding Default.

default.description: Default is an optional initial value matching Type (scalar, [x, y] for vec2, or [x, y, z] for vec3).

BTNodeDoc.description: BTNodeDoc describes one composite, decorator, leaf, or subtree reference node in a [BehaviorTreeDoc].

type.description: Type selects the behavior tree node kind.

name.description: Name is an optional label for authoring and debugging.

weight.description: Weight is the positive relative selection weight when this node is a direct child of weighted_selector.

policy.description: Policy selects the completion policy for parallel nodes: require_all (default) or require_one.

action.description: Action names the game-registered action factory for action leaf nodes.

condition.description: Condition names the game-registered condition factory for condition leaves and guard decorators.

service.description: Service names the game-registered service factory for service decorators.

duration.description: Duration is a Go duration string (such as "500ms" or "1.5s") or "${param}" reference for wait, cooldown, and time_limit nodes.

interval.description: Interval is a Go duration string or "${param}" reference controlling periodic ticks of a service decorator (omitted or "0s" runs every tick).

count.description: Count is the iteration or retry count for repeater (0 repeats indefinitely) and retry (0 disables retries) decorators.

key.description: Key is the blackboard key inspected by a blackboard_condition node.

op.description: Op is the comparison operator for a blackboard_condition node: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, set, or unset.

value.description: Value is the comparison operand for a blackboard_condition node (required for eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte; omitted for set and unset).

valueType.description: ValueType optionally specifies the blackboard type of Value (bool, int, float, string, vec2, vec3, or entity) when disambiguation is needed.

abort.description: Abort controls observer abort behavior for a blackboard_condition node: none (default), self, lower, or both.

path.description: Path is the relative or filesystem path to another *.bt.yaml file for a subtree node.

params.description: Params supplies typed parameters to action, condition, guard, service, or subtree nodes.

keys.description: Keys maps subtree-local blackboard key names to caller blackboard key names for a subtree node.

child.description: Child is the wrapped child node for decorator nodes (optional on blackboard_condition).

children.description: Children are the ordered child nodes for composite nodes.
